name: Sacred Ground
original_name: セイクリッドグラウンド
source:
There is an "Infinite bell" in this town that rings every 400 years. The person who hears it becomes next generation ruler. Town has always lived in prosperity this way. The year of bell ringing comes, and five ambitious people gather to receive its judgement. Who will receive Creator's revelation in the sacred ground?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
